author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The exact dictionary proxy route duplicates the existing `/api/v2` catch-all proxy route.
findings.consequence: The dictionary endpoint now has a second route module and route-specific unit tests to maintain even though the generic `/api/v2/[...path]` route builds the same upstream target from the same runtime `apiBase`; future proxy policy changes can drift between the duplicate exact route and the catch-all path.
findings.evidence: The owned module imports `proxyBackendRequest` and forwards the fixed backend path `dictionary/articles`. The sibling `server/routes/api/v2/[...path].ts` imports the same helper, reads the decoded catch-all path, and for `/api/v2/dictionary/articles` forwards that same `dictionary/articles` path to the same `apiBase`. The relevant `test/unit/dictionary-proxy.spec.ts` imports this exact route directly, so the test reinforces the duplicate route rather than proving behavior unavailable through the catch-all.
findings.recommendation: Delete `server/routes/api/v2/dictionary/articles.get.ts` and cover the private dictionary behavior through the existing `/api/v2/[...path]` route, or document a concrete route-precedence requirement if this exact route must intentionally shadow another handler.
